CHAPTER.VERS:
A name rather to be chosen than great riches, loving favour rather than silver and gold.
loving…: or, favour is better than, etc
The rich and poor meet together: the LORD the maker of them all.
A prudent foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.

By humility the fear of the LORD riches, and honour, and life.
By…: or, The reward of humility, etc
Thorns snares in the way of the perverse: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.

Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
Train…: or, Catechise
in…: Heb. in his way

The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower servant to the lender.
the lender: Heb. the man that lendeth

He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
the rod…: or, with the rod of his anger he shall be consumed

He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
He that…: Heb. Good of eye
Cast out the scorner, and contention shall end; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.

He that loveth pureness of heart, the grace of his lips the king his friend.
for…: or, and hath grace in his lips

The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
the words: or, the matters
The slothful saith, a lion outside, I shall be slain in the streets.
The mouth of an adulteress a deep pit: he that is abhorred by the LORD shall fall in it.
Foolishness bound in the heart of a child; the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
He that oppresseth the poor to increase his he that giveth to the rich, surely to want.
Bow down thy ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thy heart to my knowledge.

For a pleasant thing if thou keepest them within thee; they shall all be ready on thy lips.
within…: Heb. in thy belly

That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.
even…: or, trust thou also
Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,

That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send to thee?
to them…: or, to those that send thee?
Rob not the poor, because he poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
For the LORD will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.
Be not thou of them that strike hands, of them that are sureties for debts.
If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?

Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
landmark: or, bound

Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before obscure .
mean…: Heb. obscure men
